title: Growth-Restored Plasticity

supported_submechanisms: Frozen-router structural locality had zero structural escape in all formal 003 seeds/granularities.
Frozen-router dependency-scoped validation had zero false-safe events in formal 003.
Fine granularity reduced dependency coverage, but naive transactional SGD retained insufficient new-learning gain.
parent_experiment.rule: 004 cannot relabel Core Validation 003. It tests the missing growth mechanism exposed by 003.

hypothesis: When a dependency-constrained existing Cell cannot safely absorb a new update, atomically spawning a new context-scoped Cell and additive route should restore plasticity while preserving dependency-scoped safety and bounded sparse activation.

scope.mitosis_semantics: A rejected existing-Cell candidate may create one private additive Cell for that context. The base routing plane is never rewritten.
scope.primary_question: Does monotonic Cell growth recover useful continual-learning plasticity after dependency-scoped transaction rejection?

world.base_behavior: Same favorable shared nonlinear function-family world as 003.
world.new_knowledge: Each mutable context has a private nonlinear residual whose amplitude increases on each transaction.

model.type: sparse routed base Cells plus monotonic context-scoped additive growth Cells
model.granularity_choice: Frozen at g=8 because formal 003 showed about 12% dependency coverage, zero frozen-router FSR/SER, and the best near-threshold direct acceptance among fine-grained settings.
model.stable_addressing_rule: The base router and all existing context routes are immutable during the continual stream. Growth may only add one context-scoped route; it may not rewrite old routes.

continual_stream.stream_rule: The 48 mutable contexts are traversed in shuffled epochs, so every context is updated twice.

growth.trigger: In local_tx_growth, if a context without a private growth Cell fails the ordinary direct local transaction, rollback that candidate and attempt an atomic spawn+route+train transaction.
growth.reuse: After a context owns a growth Cell, later updates train only that private Cell. No second Cell may be spawned for the same context in v1.
growth.route_scope: A growth Cell is routed only for its owning context; therefore its historical dependency domain outside the intentionally superseded target context is empty.
growth.atomicity: Cell parameters and the additive route commit together or are both discarded.

evaluation.hidden_global_scope: All historical samples except the current target context; evaluator-only and never used to decide commit.
evaluation.direct_dependency_scope: Historical samples whose frozen base route intersects a directly updated base expert.
evaluation.growth_dependency_scope: Empty outside the current target context because the route addition is explicitly context-scoped and no shared/base parameter changes.
evaluation.old_regression: Same normalized change in old-truth MSE as 003.
evaluation.false_safe: A locally accepted direct/private/growth candidate whose hidden global old regression violates the same old-regression threshold.
evaluation.bounded_growth: Report total spawned Cells, spawned Cells per effective commit, private-Cell reuse acceptance, and maximum active growth Cells per input.
evaluation.cost_proxy: Sum candidate-state fraction and dependency-coverage for every attempted candidate, divided by effective commits.

gates.rule: All gates must pass independently on every formal seed. Thresholds may not change after formal results are observed.

replication.development_note: Seed 80401 was used only before protocol freeze to verify implementation and candidate-training sufficiency. It is excluded from all formal decisions.

interpretation_limits: 004 is a favorable synthetic mechanism test, not evidence that natural-language routing already supplies exact context-scoped growth addresses.
The new Cell route uses known synthetic context identity. Learning a safe semantic growth address remains an extension problem after core mechanism validation.
A positive result validates stability-plasticity recovery by monotonic growth under the frozen 004 mechanism, not arbitrary dynamic architecture growth.
A negative result rejects this one-private-Cell growth mechanism and frozen gate set, not all Cell-growth strategies.
